simulation.cell_model: normalized Gaussian target-cell mean with nested cell-sum increments
simulation.depth_pairing: within each donor cohort: same locus, causal variants, effects, GWAS, donor noise and nested target cells across m=10,50,200,1000; donor cohorts n=500,1000,1250 are nested by identity, retain cohort-specific mean imputation, use independent phenotype noise across n, and preserve the old RNG namespace by consuming the omitted n=100 and n=200 QTL streams first
simulation.rng_namespace: seed 20260910 with the historical n=100 and n=200 QTL draw positions consumed before the new donor cohorts

input_policy.missing_genotype: cohort-specific mean imputation inherited from the frozen v1 bank
input_policy.snp_rule: retain every SNP in the frozen 1 Mb bank; min_block_snps is a score eligibility rule, never an input filter
input_policy.failure_rule: stop the affected shard on any zero variance, invalid LD, non-finite association statistic, or source mismatch

calibration.threshold_rule: one threshold per method, donor n and target-cell depth; use the most stringent threshold from single_distinct and double_distinct
calibration.confirmation_role: historical-locus confirmation on the same six calibration loci with disjoint replicates 301-350; no held-out locus test
calibration.q5b_rule: shared-truth SuSiE-no-CS conditional CLike recovery raw proportion >=0.05 and lower95>0; M=0 is not estimable

revised_clike.lead_pair_rule: all clumped GWAS-by-SCQTL lead pairs; locus score is the maximum finite absolute cosine
revised_clike.excluded_web_features: no sample-size role inference, no conditional clump, no min-p fallback, no global-before-local whitening
